blocks.text: CAPITAL AND LABOR— PROPHETIC SIGN — James chap. 5, “‘reveals the ages and definitely depicts the very end of the age!’’ — Verse 4, ‘‘depicts at that time that rich men would heap their treasures together in association finally bringing on the very anti-christ system! Just before the return of Christ we will see much turmoil in the labor force. Finally, a world credit mark, etc. will be given! — Due to the advent of space, electronics and computers many changes are due in the days people work and the money and benefits that they receive! The god of science is due to make dramatic changes in our system!”’ — Verses 7-9, ‘‘reveal that it will be a time when people need patience and a firm grip. It prophesies that the Lord will receive His fruit from the former and latter rain revival. (Translation) It says the coming of the Lord draweth nigh! — It would be a time during arguments, perplexity and confusion! And again it says be patient, His return is soon! — Watch the SIGNS!’ — ‘‘The prophetic outlook of the world economy at the time of Jesus’ return portrays a sudden rush of events of scientific, political and financial changes that will literally shake the earth in preparing the way for a world dictator! — The prophet wrote, the end thereof shall be with a flood (of events)!’’ — Dan. 9:26.

THE COMING DRASTIC EARTH CHANGES— ‘‘Some total changes are in the making now and in the years ahead; but after the comets in the later 80’s the world governments, people and nations will totally be reconstructed! — The whole earth will practically be redone to fit into the hands of the antichrist!’ — ‘‘From what the Lord revealed to me, ordinary people without spiritual insight just could not believe what is really going to take place! — They won’t even know that this is the same world that they have lived in! But prophecy foretells it is so! — We are entering the final phases; God’s clock is ticking, His return is near . . . time is vanishing!”’

THE PROPHET DANIEL WROTE— ‘‘At the end of the age many shall run to and fro, meaning going back and forth by quick passage, cars, jets, etc. and that knowledge of mankind shall be increased! — Today, according to prophecy, scientists will be planning space cities and new cities upon the earth! — Men are trying new ways to provide water in the Middle East, etc. Evidently they will try to pipe water from the Arctic or bring it in for use somehow in their plans!’’ — ‘‘The anti-christ will reveal to them many ways to do wonders and other things, that they have never dreamed of before, shall he promote along with master deception to lead men away in a ‘fantasy world’ of worship!’’ — ‘‘Notice one final word . . . how perfect the Bible describes their space program!’’ — Amos 9:2, ‘‘Though they ‘climb’ up to heaven. And they have, climb means ‘step by step’ upward! — Then now they are using shuttle, then finally the Bible describes they will have living quarters for little cities! It is said (Obad. 1:4), set thy nest among the stars (nest, living facilities). But in both scriptures, He said, I will bring them down. And their space program will be interrupted like the Tower of Babel was!’’

CONTINUING— KNOWLEDGE SHALL BE INCREASED — ‘Whether man completes his plans or not, let us check the latest ideas of what they are working on. — They envision the planetran . . . that could cross the U.S.A. coast-to-coast in 21 minutes — at 14,000 miles an hour! — It would zoom like a bullet through a friction-free super subway on a ‘magnetic wave,’ without any contacts with rails or tracks!’’ — ‘‘We can see with all these coming inventions there will be more idle time for pleasure and trouble!’’ — ‘‘Transcontinental travel through the skies is expected at some point in the future. Giant flying wings would circle the globe at incredible heights and speeds in a short period, picking up and dropping off passengers! — It would seat 4,000 people, constantly circling the globe!’’ . . . ‘‘Satellites may guide future cars; it could be ready before or by 1990. It will be an electronic map known as a global positioning system. A ray tube is installed in the dash board and then it will display on a map the desired area on the screen. The auto picks up the signals from the satellite and they can be guided to the area that they would like to go to, shown on an electronic map. If one is lost on the highway or in the city, they can be guided where they want to go to!”’

HOW FAR WILL MAN GO?— What price beauty and vanity! — We are living in a weird and strange world wherein every day people find new ways to make money. Quote: — ‘‘It was only a matter of time until some realized the profit that could be made from baby fetuses that were discarded as garbage through abortion. . . . French cosmetics have taken the lead in the latest creation of the most expensive and exotic beauty treatment ever!’’ — ‘‘Beauty experts, looking for a magical rejuvenator for old and tired skin that had lost its ‘luster and resiliency’ recognized living cells could be extracted from the fetus of the aborted baby! A revolutionary treatment of cellular regeneration uses the technique of freezing. . . . These cells are frozen at —80 degrees and preserved at —20 degrees until used! — In this frozen condition they act as a poultice on older tissues. Results are visible, skin circulation is activated, coloring is pinker and fresher, texture is finer, blotches disappear, undoubtedly deeper lines and wrinkles are lessened, skin is transformed, elasticity and tone are retrieved!’’ “Frozen human fetuses coming from Central Europe are destined for the laboratories of the French cosmetic firms. Women and men see all of these new inventions as ways to prolong their pleasure and night mischief, but it will only create more problems!’’ — ‘‘Christ and His anointing is the answer to beauty! — It works inside and out literally!”’

THE MICROELECTRONIC EXPLOSION— (Dan. 12:4, super knowledge) — Quote: — ‘“‘It is mind boggling, the impossible is becoming possible in electronics! A product called micromemories is now able to put a library in your pocket!’’ — ‘‘Also predicted is an entire encyclopedia on a single 14-inch disk. Put it in the disk player, name the subject you want to study and the text appears upon the screen complete with sound effects, moving pictures, music or the spoken word!”’ — ‘‘Also there is an impressive, laser-encoded disk like a phonograph record that contains, on one side, every word contained in 173,000 books, equivalent to a college library. . . . They are also working on super computers that can perform 10 billion transactions in one second! — They are also working on computing by light that which will even transact more per second and finally they say do the genius in incredible fantastic knowledge! — Scientific men wonder where it is all headed!”’.. . . ‘‘That’s not hard to imagine. Evidently a computer bank will hold all names in it, giving forth a global mark! So, we see at the end a god of science at the hand of the anti-christ takes over and is actually worshipped!’’ — Dan. 11:38-39, ‘‘may have mentioned this strange god of science or associated to it!’ — Rev. 13:13-15, ‘‘may have included the science miracles and micromarvels that are occurring now!’’ — “‘If you think all of this is odd and mind boggling read the next article concerning the sophisticated human-like robots!”’

DRAMATIC EVENTS— OBSERVING THE TIMES — (Rom. 1:21, 30-31) We will quote what science says, things to come: Reprint, in February 1978 edition of Time, ‘‘Dr. Robert Jastrow predicted that the later computers would not only out-think men and women, but would even outdo them in many areas of intelligence and personality. In his recent book, The Enchanted Loom, Dr. Jastrow further predicted that the new computers would become a living entity and even assume human personality. To match the desired personality, computers will be programed to talk in either male or female voices.’’ . . . Carrying the counselling computers one step further, experts are now predicting that people will actually be marrying computer robots in the near future and/or sensuous ‘‘life size’? computer dolls. (The first phase of this was mentioned in Scroll #87.)

Our earlier literature mentions these subjects of the future. . . . In part from ‘‘Computer World Magazine’’ — In the 90’s people will be ‘‘marrying’’ robots as surrogate human beings! — Arthur Harkins said The ‘marriage’ need not conform to the standard Christian approach of ‘for a lifetime.’ It may be for a weekend, for a day, for a year...”’ Supposing, robots can be programmed with pleasing personalities or a temper, a sense of humor or a musical talent, will their companionability extend to sexual liaisons? Yes, according to Harkins. ‘‘The Japanese have already developed all kinds of mechanical substitutes for human sexual organs, which are implanted in a robot and-can be embellished with heat and other types of human-like characteristics,” he reported. In addition, it will become more and more difficult to physically distinguish robots from humans. . . . ‘‘The metal, fiber or carbon filament . . . will be concealed by a decorative outer covering, which could be clothing, fur or an artifical skin with the warmth and texture of healthy human skin.”’

Gospel Truth Magazine quote: ‘‘The companionship and sexual expectations of both men and women today have been so exaggerated and fantasized by television, movies and pornographic publications that some members of the Opposite sex cannot satisfy each other. This is one reason for the spiraling divorce rate and live-in arrangements. Jesus said: ‘‘. . . as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be’’ (Matthew 24:37). Gen. 6:5 — Read Rom. 1:30 — II Tim. 3:1-4 — Isa. 8:19.

“Inasmuch as men and women are finding it increasingly difficult to experience fulfillment in each other, computerized robots are being designed that will be everything that a man or woman may want. Order to exact specifications. — The image of the beast that will speak and command everyone to take his mark and number could be the ultimate computer idol or god. Certainly, all these ungodly and Satanically inspired imaginations of the human mind is leading to that time prophesied in Revelation 13:8-15.
